surfaces.name: Source Control
surfaces.scope: Local Git status, compare, stage, unstage, safe discard, recent history, and simple commits.
surfaces.keyboard_review: Changed-file rows activate compare from the list row; Stage, Unstage, and Discard are always visible icon buttons with accessible labels and disabled-reason descriptions.
surfaces.screen_reader_review: Status badges expose text labels, staged markers expose a Staged label, and row action buttons expose action names plus disabled reasons when unavailable.
surfaces.high_contrast_review: Status still uses text badges, action icons, and tooltips/descriptions, so color is supplemental.
surfaces.narrow_width_review: Commit controls are revealed only when staged changes can be committed, reducing persistent sidebar density at narrow widths.
surfaces.limits: Riteed intentionally does not provide remotes, branch switching, push, pull, fetch, merge, rebase, conflict resolution, credential storage, terminal, build, or hook-running workflows.

surfaces.name: Compare
surfaces.scope: Read-only split diff for manual compare and Source Control Git compare.
surfaces.keyboard_review: F8 and Shift+F8 move between differences and the compare toolbar keeps icon buttons accessible by labels.
surfaces.screen_reader_review: Compare panes are read-only presentation views; generated placeholder markers remain visible text and should be included in future manual assistive-technology testing.
surfaces.high_contrast_review: Compare rendering keeps high-contrast fallbacks and does not rely on red/green alone because gutters, row positions, and placeholder rows also convey state.
surfaces.narrow_width_review: The split view remains tab-local and exits back to the normal editor rather than opening additional window surfaces.
surfaces.limits: Editable merge, conflict resolution, patch staging, and multi-file compare sessions remain out of scope.
